title: Northbeam TechWorks Payment Terms Note: Charges Carried to the Next Invoice
content:
What is left for the next invoice on a Northbeam TechWorks Installation and Repair job turns on whether the job carries charges booked on the day of settlement and on how far back the day the work was asked for lies against the service's payment terms.

**Where the job carries charges booked on the day of settlement and the day the work was asked for lies further back than the service's payment terms**, only the charges booked on the day of settlement are left for the next invoice, the earlier charges having already run their terms.

**Where the job carries charges booked on the day of settlement and the day the work was asked for lies inside the service's payment terms**, nothing is left for the next invoice, because the whole of the job still sits on the invoice now being settled.

**Where neither situation holds**, what is left for the next invoice is the charges booked on the day of settlement together with the fees the settlement covers.

## The payment terms each service carries

The comparison counts the days from the day the work was asked for to the day of settlement against the service's payment terms in days: further back than those terms means more days than the terms allow, and the terms themselves are inside them.

| TechWorks service | Days a business account may take to settle, and the term this comparison uses |
| --- | --- |
| TechWorks In Store Bench Service | 0 |
| TechWorks Standard Home Installation | 0 |
| TechWorks Home Theatre Calibration | 0 |
| TechWorks Appliance Install and Haul Away | 0 |
| TechWorks Business On Site Deployment | 30 |
| TechWorks Managed IT Care Annual | 45 |

## The readings side by side

| Charges booked on the day of settlement | The day the work was asked for | Left for the next invoice |
| --- | --- | --- |
| one or more | further back than the service's payment terms | the charges booked on the day of settlement |
| one or more | inside the service's payment terms | nothing |
| none | either | the charges booked on the day of settlement together with the fees the settlement covers |

The third reading is reached where no charge at all is booked on the day of settlement, in which case the charges of that day come to nothing and what is left is the fees the settlement covers.

## Illustrations on hypothetical jobs

*The amounts and day counts below are chosen for the illustration and are not those of any job on file.*

**An annual care job with no charge booked on the day of settlement.** The third reading governs: what is left is nothing from that day together with the fees the settlement covers, so it is the fees the settlement covers.

**An annual care job twenty-eight days old.** 318.00 USD is booked on the day of settlement and the work was asked for 28 days earlier, inside the 45 days the service's payment terms allow, so nothing is left for the next invoice.

**The same job fifty-two days old.** The work was asked for 52 days earlier, further back than those 45 days, so 318.00 USD is left for the next invoice.
